preset.adoptedNote: The new parameters fit your reviews better and are saved. Undo in the message below puts the old ones back.
preset.evalNote: How well the current parameters predict your past answers. Lower is better.
preset.f.replayQuestionAudio: Replay question audio on the answer
preset.group.advanced.lede: Caps and the classic SM-2 multipliers. Most people never touch these.
preset.group.burying.lede: Keeps related cards (siblings from the same note) off the same day so one does not give away the other.
preset.group.fsrs.lede: The scheduler that predicts when you are about to forget, fitted to your own history.
preset.group.lapses.lede: What happens when you forget a card you knew.
preset.group.new.lede: How a card is learned before it starts being scheduled in days.
preset.group.order.lede: Which cards come first, and how new cards and reviews are mixed.
preset.group.timer.lede: Answer timing, used for statistics and time estimates.
preset.h.autoOptimise: Refit the parameters to your own answers in the background once enough new reviews have built up.
preset.h.autoplayAudio: Play a card’s sounds when it appears. You can always replay with R.
preset.h.burySiblingsInterday: Also hold back siblings that are in multi-day learning.
preset.h.burySiblingsNew: Hold back other new cards from the same note until tomorrow.
preset.h.burySiblingsReview: Hold back other review cards from the same note until tomorrow.
preset.h.desiredRetention: The chance you want of remembering a card when it comes due. Each extra point costs noticeably more reviews.
preset.h.easyBonus: Extra multiplier when you press Easy on a review.
preset.h.easyInterval: Days until the first review when you press Easy on a new card.
preset.h.fsrsParams: The 21 weights of your memory model. Optimise fits them to your reviews; evaluate tells you how well they predict.
preset.h.graduatingInterval: Days until the first review after a card passes its last learning step.
preset.h.hardMultiplier: Multiplier applied to the interval when you press Hard.
preset.h.historicalRetention: Your retention before FSRS. Used to estimate memory state for cards with incomplete history.
preset.h.initialEase: SM-2’s multiplier for a newly graduated card. 250% is Anki’s default.
preset.h.interdayLearningMix: Where learning cards that waited overnight appear relative to reviews.
preset.h.intervalModifier: Scales every SM-2 interval. Below 1 means more reviews and better retention.
preset.h.lapseMultiplier: The share of the old interval a forgotten card keeps. 0% starts it over.
preset.h.learnSteps: Short delays before a new card graduates, e.g. 1m 10m. With FSRS, keep them under a day.
preset.h.leechAction: Tag them so you can find and fix them, or suspend them so they stop costing time.
preset.h.leechThreshold: After this many lapses a card is marked as struggling and Loci offers to help rewrite it.
preset.h.maxAnswerSeconds: Longer answers are recorded as this long, so a break does not distort your statistics.
preset.h.maximumInterval: The longest gap between reviews, in days. The default is a hundred years.
preset.h.minimumLapseInterval: The shortest interval, in days, a forgotten card can get once relearned.
preset.h.minutesPerDay: Your study target in minutes. Home estimates against it and catch-up plans use it; it never blocks cards.
preset.h.newGather: Where today’s new cards are taken from when you study a parent deck.
preset.h.newOrder: Whether new cards keep the order they were added in or are shuffled when added.
preset.h.newPerDay: The most new cards introduced in a day. Each brings roughly ten reviews over its first month.
preset.h.newReviewMix: Show new cards spread among reviews, or all before or after them.
preset.h.newSort: How the gathered new cards are ordered before you see them.
preset.h.optimiseEveryReviews: How many new reviews trigger an automatic optimisation.
preset.h.relearnSteps: Delays after you forget a review card, before it goes back to being scheduled in days.
preset.h.replayQuestionAudio: When the answer is shown, play the question’s audio again before the answer’s.
preset.h.reviewOrder: The order of today’s reviews. Due date then random suits almost everyone.
preset.h.reviewsPerDay: A hard cap on reviews. Loci leaves it high and plans with your daily time instead, so nothing quietly piles up.
preset.h.scheduler: FSRS models your memory and needs fewer reviews for the same retention. SM-2 is Anki’s classic algorithm.
preset.h.showIntervalsOnButtons: Show, above each answer button, when the card would come back.
preset.h.showTimer: Show a small clock on the study screen.
preset.leaveBody: The options you changed on this page have not been saved.
preset.paramsInvalid: That isn’t a list of 17, 19 or 21 numbers.
preset.paramsPasteHelp: Paste 21 numbers (17 or 19 from older FSRS versions are upgraded), separated by commas.

studyScreen.previewPillTitle: Preview session: answers are not recorded and your schedule does not change.

cardInfoPanel.recallHelp: If you saw it right now, you would remember it about {percent} of the time.
cardInfoPanel.recallUnknown: Not known until the first review.

catchUpView.oldest: The oldest has waited {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
catchUpView.pace: At your usual {average} a day, that is {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of work.
catchUpView.notBehind: You are not behind; these plans are here if you want them.
catchUpView.whyMore: Cards are postponed in order of how likely you are to still remember them, so nothing at risk waits.

sentence.spread: About {perDay} reviews a day for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({duration} a day). Cards at risk come first; the safest wait their turn.
sentence.todayShare: {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} today ({duration}), your usual amount. {rest, plural, =0 {Nothing else needs to move.} other {The other # move gently forward, safest first.}}
sentence.lowerRetention: For {days} days, aim to remember {target} instead of {current}. Intervals stretch a little, about {fewer}% fewer reviews, then everything returns to normal.
sentence.studyAll: All {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} stay due today, about {duration}. Nothing moves.

catchUpView.loadFailed: The backlog could not be measured
catchUpView.clearBody: No reviews are waiting. Enjoy the quiet.
catchUpView.resultNote: Changed your mind? Undo puts every card back where it was.
